level.adolescence.desc: The bridge from child to adult — study, friendship, first love, rebellion. Pass by turning 19.
level.elder.desc: Look back, find peace, leave a legacy. Pass by turning 100.
item.toy.desc: The tin robot or the rag doll — a small friend that outlasts the person you were.
item.book.desc: Paper worlds; read one and a window opens in your head.
item.snack.desc: Sweet, cheap, immediate — buy it when the day has been long.
item.coffee.desc: A hot cup at three buys two clear hours, then charges interest.
item.medicine.desc: Bitter, and it works; most of your health back, and no arguing.
item.bike.desc: Climb on and the city shrinks; the legs remember.
item.guitar.desc: Four chords are enough to be the one the party remembers.
item.gift.desc: Something wrapped, something meant — give it to someone who matters.
item.diploma.desc: A certificate, framed or not — proof those years were not wasted.
item.watch.desc: It ticks whether or not you are paying attention.
item.lottery.desc: A folded square of hope — scratch it and see.
item.ring.desc: A promise small enough for a finger, heavy enough for a life.
npc.mom.desc: Lin Huiqin, thirty years holding this house together — she mends what tears, remembers every birthday, and worries louder than she scolds.
npc.dad.desc: Lin Guomin, a foreman who talks with his hands; he has never once said he is proud of you, and keeps every clipping about you in a drawer.
npc.friend.desc: Wei, who has known you since you shared one desk — you have quarreled, made up, and outlasted every other friendship you own.
npc.teacher.desc: Mr. Cao, whose glasses always slip, and who still signs his own name under every comment he writes.
npc.partner.desc: Yan, who chose you back when you had nothing, and reads your silence the way other people read a billboard.
npc.boss.desc: Director Sun, who built the department from nothing and treats every employee as a number with a face.
npc.child.desc: Your child, all elbows and questions, currently planning to be an astronaut and a baker at the same time.
ev.kindergarten_show.text: Teacher Fang is casting the year-end show, and you have been given one line — three words — to say in front of the whole hall.
ev.kindergarten_show.note.perform: Your voice comes out small but clear. Your mother films the whole thing on a borrowed camera.
ev.kindergarten_show.note.refuse: You whisper the line to the curtain instead. Teacher Fang writes nothing in her book — which is worse than writing something.
ev.toy_broken.text: The tin robot your father brought back from his trip has stopped mid-step; one arm hangs loose.
ev.toy_broken.opt.fix: Take it apart and try to mend it
ev.toy_broken.note.fix: You lose two screws and find them a week later, but the arm moves again. You did that.
ev.toy_broken.note.cry: Your mother turns the arm the wrong way and makes it worse. You cry harder; she goes quiet.
ev.toy_broken.opt.accept: Stand it on the shelf as it is
ev.toy_broken.note.accept: It stands there one-armed for years, and you stop seeing the missing arm.
ev.stray_cat.text: A kitten with a torn ear keeps returning to your gate; today it finally lets you come close.
ev.stray_cat.note.adopt: You name it before you reach the door. It will sleep at the foot of your bed for eleven years.
ev.stray_cat.opt.feed: Leave it a saucer of milk
ev.stray_cat.note.feed: It drinks with one eye on you, then goes. The saucer is licked clean.
ev.stray_cat.note.ignore: It watches you go. You tell yourself you'll feed it tomorrow.
ev.school_bully.text: A boy two rows behind you has started taking your eraser and calling you names the teacher never hears.
ev.school_bully.note.fight: You both land in the nurse's office. He leaves you alone after that — and so does everyone else.
ev.school_bully.note.teacher: The teacher moves you to the front row and keeps you after class to talk about 'courage'. His friends remember.
ev.school_bully.note.endure: You learn to keep your pencil case in your lap, and your feelings somewhere lower.
ev.school_contest.text: The school is picking four names for the district quiz; your teacher writes yours on the board without asking.
ev.school_contest.note.join: You study through lunch for six weeks. You place third, and remember the third question for the rest of your life.
ev.school_contest.note.skip: You keep your lunches and your evenings. Someone else takes the glory, and you feel an odd relief.
ev.pocket_money.text: Between the elders' red envelopes you are suddenly rich — three hundred and fifty, more than you have ever held.
ev.pocket_money.opt.save: Hand it to your mother to keep
ev.pocket_money.note.save: She opens a passbook in your name and puts it away. You never see the money again, but it is there.
ev.pocket_money.opt.snack: Spend it on sweets and soda
ev.pocket_money.note.snack: Three days of sugar, then a stomachache on the fourth.
ev.pocket_money.opt.book: Buy the book you keep staring at
ev.pocket_money.note.book: You read it twice before the new term; the shopkeeper remembers you after that.
ev.first_friend.text: A new student stands alone at the fence every recess, tracing circles in the dirt with the toe of his shoe.
ev.first_friend.note.approach: You end up sharing a desk for the next six years. He is the one you tell things to first.
ev.first_friend.note.alone: You read where you are. Later you won't remember his name — only that you almost went.
ev.family_trip.text: Your father borrows a car and drives six hours to a lake none of you have seen; your mother packs enough food for twelve.
ev.child_sick.text: You wake in the dark with the room tilting, your mother's hand already on your forehead and her other arm reaching for her coat.
ev.exam_cram.text: The final exam is at eight; the clock says half past one, and the whole floor is still awake.
ev.exam_cram.note.cram: You fill three pages with what you already know and nothing you don't. The room smells of instant coffee.
ev.exam_cram.note.sleep: You wake clear-headed. Two questions you would have stared at for an hour answer themselves.
ev.exam_cram.opt.cheat: Copy the answers onto your palm
ev.exam_cram.note.cheat: You sit on your hand all morning. It works, and something in you keeps glancing over its shoulder for years.
ev.first_love.text: She turns to borrow a pen, and something in your chest forgets how it works.
ev.first_love.note.confess: You pass the note with shaking hands. She reads it twice.
ev.first_love.opt.secret: Write it in a diary instead
ev.first_love.note.secret: The diary fills up. Nobody ever reads it, including her.
ev.first_love.note.study: Your marks climb all term, and you barely notice the empty seat when she changes classes.
ev.club.text: Every club has a table in the yard; the basketball captain and the poetry editor are both waving at you.
ev.club.note.sport: Three practices a week. By spring you can run the whole court without stopping.
ev.club.note.literature: You read three books the others have never heard of, and start writing in the margins.
ev.club.note.none: You go home to your own room and keep your evenings whole.
ev.peer_pressure.text: Behind the bike shed the older boys pass a cigarette around; halfway through the circle, it reaches you.
ev.peer_pressure.note.indulge: You cough, they laugh, and the circle opens for you. Your chest tastes of ash for a week.
ev.peer_pressure.note.refuse: You hand it back. The circle doesn't exactly close, but it stops opening.
ev.peer_pressure.note.report: Three of them are suspended, and everyone knows who told. The word follows you through the year.
ev.math_olympiad.text: Mr. Cao slides you a form for the provincial maths olympiad and says, without smiling, that you could do worse.
ev.math_olympiad.note.join: You spend your evenings on problems nobody in your class can read. Some of them are beautiful.
ev.math_olympiad.opt.skip: Leave the form on the desk
ev.math_olympiad.note.skip: You take the ordinary maths and the ordinary evenings, and you are not unhappy.
ev.family_fight.text: At dinner your father says you will study medicine; you have already decided otherwise.
ev.family_fight.note.argue: The words land like plates. Your mother clears the table and says nothing. Nobody apologizes for a month.
ev.family_fight.note.talk: You explain slowly; he listens slowly. Neither of you moves, but the door stays open.
ev.family_fight.note.cold: You stop speaking at meals. The silence grows a ceiling and a floor.
ev.graduation.text: On the last day the whole year stands in the yard; the teacher reads out names and, for the first time, no one tells you what comes next.
ev.graduation.note.university: You leave home with two suitcases and come back different at New Year.
ev.graduation.note.work: You earn your first month's pay and hand half to your mother; she puts it in a drawer and never spends it.
ev.heartbreak.text: The phone call lasts four minutes; you stand in the stairwell for a while afterward.
ev.love_yes.text: She nods before you finish the sentence. You walk home the long way, to make the walk last longer.
ev.love_no.text: She thanks you for being honest, and means it, mostly.
ev.parttime.text: A classmate says the noodle shop on the corner needs a hand at weekends.
ev.parttime.note.take: Six yuan an hour and all the leftovers you can carry. Your hands smell of scallion for a year.
ev.parttime.note.decline: You keep your Saturdays and your sleep, and watch him buy new shoes.
ev.interview.text: Three envelopes lie on the table: a state firm with a dormitory, a private company with a higher salary, and a graduate place with your name on it.
ev.interview.note.corp: The dormitory has heating and a queue for the shower. Your father tells the neighbours you got in.
ev.interview.note.startup: The salary is triple and the contract is one page. By March you learn what 'unlimited overtime' means.
ev.interview.note.study: You stay in the library two more years. The envelopes stop coming, and you tell yourself that is fine.
ev.promotion.text: The director offers you deputy manager — the title, the small raise, and the desk by the window that never quite closes.
ev.promotion.note.accept: Your card gains a line. Your evenings gain an owner.
ev.promotion.note.negotiate: You name a number; he laughs, then meets you two-thirds of the way. Nobody forgets that you asked.
ev.promotion.note.decline: You keep your evenings and your colleague's goodwill. The title goes to someone who wanted it more.
ev.marriage.text: You have been together four years; her mother has started asking, at every meal, what your plans are.
ev.marriage.note.propose: You do it badly, in a stairwell. She says yes before you finish.
ev.marriage.note.wait: You swallow the words. She nods, and something behind her eyes files it away.
ev.house.text: The lease is up, and you have enough for a down payment on a flat two bus stops past the ring road.
ev.house.note.buy: Thirty years of mortgage, and keys that are yours. You paint the living room the colour your mother hates.
ev.house.note.rent: You stay fifteen minutes from the office and never fix anything, because it isn't yours.
ev.house.opt.parents: Move back in with your parents
ev.house.note.parents: You save the rent and pay in other ways — your mother rearranges your room while you're at work.
ev.child.text: The test shows two lines. You sit on the edge of the bath and do the arithmetic of money, space, and fear.
ev.child.note.have: The flat shrinks and the nights shorten. You learn to sleep in forty-minute pieces, and are happier than you expected.
ev.child.note.later: You both agree it isn't time. You will think about this decision on quiet evenings for years.
ev.invest.text: A cousin's friend has a scheme that cannot fail: nine percent a month, paid in cash, no questions.
ev.invest.note.risky: You hand over the envelope. For two months the returns arrive, folded, in person.
ev.invest.note.safe: You take the three percent a year and watch him drive past in a new car, for now.
ev.layoff.text: The plant posts the names on Friday; yours is fourth from the bottom, printed in the same font as everyone else's.
ev.layoff.note.retrain: You learn bookkeeping between shifts. Two years later it is the thing that saves you.
ev.layoff.note.hunt: You send forty applications and take the first interview that calls back.
ev.layoff.note.rest: You sleep for a month, then begin to remember what your own face feels like.
ev.charity.text: A woman stands by the market gate with a box for the flood families, shaking it without much hope.
ev.charity.note.donate: She writes your name in a notebook nobody else will read. You feel lighter for a week.
ev.charity.note.refuse: You cross to the other side of the street. The box keeps shaking behind you.
ev.old_friend.text: A name you haven't seen in fifteen years lights up your phone, asking if you remember him.
ev.old_friend.note.reunite: Two hours become four. You are both nineteen again until the bill arrives.
ev.old_friend.note.decline: You type and delete three replies. He stops asking after the second year.
ev.burnout.text: You have stopped sleeping properly; the work still gets done, but you can no longer remember why it matters.
ev.invest_win.text: The returns arrive exactly as promised, and you briefly believe you are clever.
ev.invest_lose.text: The office is empty and the phone is disconnected. Your money is gone the way money goes.
ev.retire.text: On your last afternoon you hand in the badge, the keys, and the mug nobody ever washed for you. The gate closes behind you at 5:40.
ev.retire.note.travel: You take the slow trains and eat standing at station counters. At one mountain you cry and cannot say why.
ev.retire.note.grandkids: You learn the children's songs again and the names of dinosaurs you had never heard of.
ev.retire.opt.work: Find work to fill the days
ev.retire.note.work: You take a job watching a warehouse. You could sleep, but you don't; it feels like being needed.
ev.health_scare.text: The doctor holds the film up to the window and does not look at you while he talks; the word he uses is 'shadow'.
ev.health_scare.note.surgery: Sixty thousand and three weeks in a ward. You come out lighter and, for the first time, careful.
ev.health_scare.note.conservative: You take the pills and keep the secret from your son for a year. The cough stays.
ev.legacy.text: A journalist from the local paper asks, for a feature, what you would like to be remembered for.
ev.legacy.note.memoir: You fill four exercise books in your own hand. Your granddaughter will read them at twenty.
ev.legacy.note.mentor: You take two apprentices. One of them will do the thing you never managed.
ev.legacy.note.donate_all: You fund three school places in the county you left at eighteen. Nobody there knows your name.
ev.grandchild.text: Your son's child lets go of his hand and walks straight to your chair, because you are the one who keeps sweets.
ev.grandchild.note.spoil: Every visit ends with a folded tenner and a promise not to tell their father.
ev.grandchild.note.teach: You teach them to whistle through a blade of grass, the way your own grandfather taught you.
ev.friend_passing.text: You are the last of your class; the fourth name goes into the paper in the same small font as the others.
ev.gentle_years.text: The days arrive without being asked for: tea at seven, the market at nine, the afternoon nap, the evening news.
traits.title: Choose traits
traits.hint: Pick up to {max}; Enter toggles. Applied when a new life starts.
shop.title: Shop
shop.hint: Enter to buy, Esc to go back
npc.colleague.desc: Old Zhou, two cubicles over, who shares snacks and warnings in equal measure.
npc.neighbor.desc: Auntie Cui from upstairs, who keeps spare keys for half the building and knows whose cat is whose.
npc.pet.desc: A dog you named on a whim; he has outlived two of your phones and all of your moods.
item.tea.desc: Warm, quiet, unhurried; it puts the day back in order.
item.vitamin.desc: Not a cure, but a nudge; the body takes what it can.
item.textbook.desc: Dense, dry, and the fastest road to the number that matters.
item.perfume.desc: A signature smell; the room notices you before you speak.
item.gympass.desc: A month of mornings you will either dread or love.
item.laptop.desc: A small black rectangle that thinks faster than you do (intelligence +4, reusable).
item.car.desc: Four wheels and a door that shuts out the weather (happiness +5, reusable).
level.youth.desc: Into the world — work, love and self-discovery. Pass by turning 35.
level.midlife.desc: Heaviest responsibilities — career, family, health. Pass by turning 60.
ev.new_job_offer.text: Two weeks after graduation a call comes: a clerk's post at the district machinery bureau, starting Monday.
ev.new_job_offer.note.accept: You buy a white shirt and a tie with a stain on the back. The bus to the bureau leaves at 6:10.
ev.new_job_offer.note.decline: You tell your father you can do better. He doesn't argue; he just stops asking.
ev.hobby.text: You suddenly have evenings that aren't for anything, and you don't know what to do with your hands.
ev.hobby.note.music: You learn four chords and play them at every gathering until your friends beg you to stop.
ev.hobby.note.sport: Five kilometres by autumn. You are astonished by what your own legs will do.
ev.hobby.note.reading: You read eleven books in a winter nobody else in your building knows about.
ev.pet: A Wet Nose at the Door
ev.pet.text: A neighbour's dog has a litter, and the smallest one keeps following your shoes.
ev.pet.note.adopt: It chews your best shoes and you forgive it every time. You talk to it more than to most people.
ev.pet.note.no: You keep your evenings and your floors clean, and something missing.
ev.neighbor_help.text: Your neighbour knocks at ten at night: her water heater has burst and her husband is away.
ev.neighbor_help.note.help: You are soaked to the knees by midnight. She brings you dumplings for a week.
ev.neighbor_help.note.refuse: You hear the water running through the wall until two in the morning.
ev.travel.text: There is a map on your office wall with three pin holes in it, all from a trip you took at twenty-two.
ev.travel.note.go: You go alone, eat badly, and see a sea you had only ever seen in photographs.
ev.travel.opt.stay: Leave the pins where they are
ev.travel.note.stay: You take your annual leave at home, sleeping late and fixing the kitchen tap.
ev.side_hustle.text: A classmate calls: his cousin's shop needs its accounts done at weekends, cash, no contract.
ev.side_hustle.note.do: You earn eight hundred extra a month, and your Sundays disappear into a ledger.
ev.side_hustle.note.focus: You keep your weekends whole. The classmate stops calling after a while.
ev.breakup.text: One of you says it first; by the weekend half the wardrobe is gone and the flat is larger.
ev.matchmaking.text: Your aunt has already ordered by the time you arrive, and the girl is already sitting there with her mother.
ev.matchmaking.note.go: She is funnier than you expected and eats more than you. You see her again the next week.
ev.matchmaking.note.skip: You make an excuse and go. Your aunt calls your mother that night.
ev.accident.text: A van runs the light at the crossing outside the market; you wake with a tube in your arm and a nurse asking your name.
ev.lottery_win.text: The coat you nearly gave away had a lottery ticket in the pocket, and it is the one they read out.
ev.low_mood.text: For three weeks you have slept badly and cried at a television advert; you have told no one.
ev.low_mood.note.doctor: The doctor listens for forty minutes and writes a name on a card. A month later the mornings are easier.
ev.low_mood.note.endure: You get through the days. Some of them you will not remember at all.
ev.mentor.text: A graduate arrives at the desk beside yours, terrified and over-qualified, holding two pens in case one runs out.
ev.mentor.note.guide: You teach them to survive the quarterly meeting. They bring you tea for a year.
ev.mentor.note.self: You finish your own work early and go home. The graduate learns from someone with less patience.
ev.family_dinner.text: Your mother has made eight dishes for six people and is already angry that you are late.
ev.family_dinner.note.attend: You still get the seat by the window and the best pieces of fish, and you are older than you feel.
ev.family_dinner.note.absent: She says fine, fine. The soup is still on the stove when you finally visit.
ev.midlife_crisis.text: You wake at four and cannot answer the simple question of whether this is the life you meant to build.
ev.midlife_crisis.note.change: You quit the committee that ate your Saturdays. Your hands stop shaking after two months.
ev.midlife_crisis.note.keep: You decide the question itself is the problem and stop asking it. Mostly.
ev.health_warning.text: The clinic's letter uses the word 'elevated' three times and suggests you come in for a repeat test.
ev.adventure_1.text: You and two friends have decided that this summer you will cycle to the reservoir — thirty kilometres each way — and camp one night.
ev.adventure_1.note.go: The first ten kilometres are glorious. Then the road starts to climb.
ev.adventure_1.note.home: You watch them go from the bus stop, eating the sandwiches you packed.
ev.adventure_2.text: Twenty kilometres out, the tyre goes flat in the middle of nowhere, and the light is already going.
ev.adventure_3.text: Your legs are finished, but the reservoir wall is visible over the last ridge.
ev.adventure_3.note.persist: You reach the water as the sun drops behind it. You will tell this story for twenty years.
ev.adventure_3.note.give_up: You push the bike the whole way back. Nobody blames you; you do.
game.perks.title: Perks
action.showoff.desc: Spend 200 for a thrill, hurting reputation
ev.public_good.text: On the footbridge a man is being kicked by two others while a small crowd films it on their phones.
ev.public_good.opt.act: Push through and pull him up
ev.public_good.note.act: You take a boot to the ribs. The video ends up online with your face in it, and the man never learns your name.
ev.public_good.note.ignore: You catch your bus. The sound of it follows you home and sits down beside you.
ev.scandal.text: Someone has screenshotted a message of yours from three years ago and posted it with a comment; by lunchtime it has four thousand shares.
ev.award.text: The district wants to give you a certificate at the annual meeting, on stage, in front of everyone who has ever doubted you.
ev.award.note.accept: You shake four hands and forget all four names. Your mother photographs the whole ceremony from the third row.
ev.award.opt.decline: Ask them to give it to someone else
ev.award.note.decline: You stay in your seat. Two people call you modest; one calls you arrogant.
ev.help_old: The Old Man at the Crossing
ev.help_old.text: An old man stands through three green lights with a bag of oranges, not daring to step off the kerb.
ev.help_old.opt.help: Take his arm and walk him over
ev.help_old.note.help: He talks the whole way about his granddaughter in the south. You are ten minutes late and don't mind.
ev.help_old.note.pass: You cross ahead of him. On the other side you look back; he is still on the kerb.
ev.online_fame.text: A friend shows you the numbers: a video of your daily life could earn more in a month than you do in a year.
ev.online_fame.note.go: You gain forty thousand followers and lose the ability to eat in a restaurant unphotographed.
ev.online_fame.note.no: You keep your face to yourself and your evenings quiet. The friend finds someone else.
ev.rumor.text: A story about you is going round the office, and by now it has grown three heads and a surname.
ev.rumor.opt.clarify: Call it out in the group chat
ev.rumor.note.clarify: You post the actual dates. The story dies, but people remember that you read the group chat closely.
ev.rumor.note.ignore: You wait it out. It fades in three weeks, and nobody ever apologises.
world.title: Chronicle of Fate
era.dawn.desc: Fields and hearths; the world is yet a wild, untilled plain.
era.iron.desc: Forge-fires never die; blades and walls redraw the land.
era.steam.desc: Gears roar; for the first time machines run for men.
era.electric.desc: Electric light banishes night; information begins to flow.
era.star.desc: Mankind lifts its eyes to the stars; sky-ports rise above the clouds.
faction.scholars.desc: Wielding knowledge as a blade, they record and explain all.
faction.merchants.desc: They price all things, and set the world in motion.
faction.wardens.desc: Guardians of the long night and order; sworn foes of the Shadows.
faction.shadows.desc: They slip through the cracks of the rules, holding unseen keys.
region.heartland.desc: A rich crossroads of trade; everyone counts carefully.
region.highland.desc: A misty city of learning where seekers watch the stars.
region.harbor.desc: Home of the Wardens; the harbor burns lights all year.
region.wastes.desc: Beyond the rules, where the Shadows take root.
fate.sage.desc: Your pursuit of wisdom awakens; scholarly chances come more often.
fate.tycoon.desc: Your ambition awakens; chances for wealth come more often.
fate.guardian.desc: Your kindness awakens; chances to do good come more often.
fate.rebel.desc: Your defiance awakens; chaotic chances come more often.
fate.scholar_path.desc: The Scholars' Council knows you; academic chances come more often.
fate.star_child.desc: Born in the Era of Stars, the constellations favour you.
codex.title: Codex
lore.first_light.body: They say the world lay in endless night until the first light fell on the Heartland.
lore.iron_pact.body: In the Era of Iron, the four powers swore a pact and drew borders with blades.
lore.steam_rise.body: On the night the first machine roared, the old order began to loosen.
lore.electric_age.body: Current flowed through the cities and the long night was lit for good.
lore.star_gate.body: Star Harbor's first gate opened; mankind looked beyond the sea of stars.
lore.scholars_secret.body: Beneath the Council lies a vault of histories that were edited.
lore.merchant_ledger.body: An old ledger records deals no one will admit to.
lore.wardens_oath.body: 'The long night comes; I shall hold the lamp.' Wardens keep this to this day.
lore.shadows_whisper.body: The Shadows keep no writing; secrets hide in the teeth of a key.
lore.kind_heart.body: Your kindness has spread, a faint light for others.
lore.dark_whisper.body: Your defiance is whispered — and followed in the dark.
lore.wise_one.body: A life of seeking has touched the deep roots of the tree of knowledge.
lore.iron_will.body: Your ambition moves even iron and stone.
lore.traveler.body: You once walked beyond the borders of home and saw a wider world.
lore.grand_design.body: Beneath the sea of stars, you finally grasp the great design of the world.
lore.crowned_rebel.body: The Shadows crown you — a legend born from the cracks of the rules.
ev.iron_forge.text: In the Era of Iron, the smithy at the crossroads takes one apprentice a year, and this year there are four names in the queue.
ev.iron_forge.note.forge: You blister your palms for three months and learn to read iron by its colour. The craft stays in your hands for life.
ev.iron_forge.note.watch: You come back every evening to watch. The smith, without turning, says the door is open if you mean it.
ev.steam_machine.text: The kingdom's first steam loom arrives on eight oxen and is set up in the mill by the river; half the town comes to stare.
ev.steam_machine.note.invest: The loom runs day and night and pays for itself within the year. The weavers who worked by hand do not.
ev.steam_machine.note.hands: You keep your own two hands and your old price. When the mill burns in the spring, you are still working.
ev.electric_night: The Night the Lights Stayed On
ev.electric_night.text: In the Era of Electric the city's lamps are lit by wire for the first time, and nobody sleeps; you walk the streets until dawn with everyone else.
ev.star_port.text: In the Era of Stars a ship waits at Star Harbor, provisioned for a crossing no one has made, with one berth still unassigned.
ev.star_port.note.voyage: You leave everyone you have ever loved on the pier and see, past the last beacon, what no one has seen.
ev.star_port.note.stay: You stand on the mole until the sails are only a thought. You are at peace, and not sure with what.
ev.scholars_offer.text: The Scholars' Council writes to you by name, asking you to join a project they will not describe in writing.
ev.scholars_offer.note.join: You spend four years in a basement archive and come out knowing three things that are true and cannot be said.
ev.scholars_offer.note.decline: You keep your life as it is. The Council writes once more, then stops.
ev.merchants_deal.text: The Merchants' Guild lays a contract on the table: a monopoly on the northern road, in exchange for a share of your name.
ev.merchants_deal.note.sign: Gold in your account and your signature on other men's letters. The Guild protects you, and owns a little more of you.
ev.merchants_deal.note.refuse: You keep your name and your independence. The northern road goes to a man with fewer scruples.
ev.wardens_duty.text: The Wardens need a sixth for the night patrol on the frontier, where three men have not come back this month.
ev.wardens_duty.note.accept: You come back with a scar and the Wardens' silence, which among them is worth more than thanks.
ev.wardens_duty.note.refuse: You sleep warm. The patrol goes out one short, and the Wardens remember.
ev.shadows_offer.text: A figure in the alley holds out a key and says only: the door it opens is not in the rules.
ev.shadows_offer.note.join: The key is warm from someone else's hand. You open the door, and after that the world has one more corridor in it.
ev.shadows_offer.note.refuse: You hand it back. The figure nods, unsurprised, and the alley closes behind you like a book.
pressures.title: Undercurrents — hidden scores
worldev.hard_winter.body: That winter ran long; the fields froze shut.
worldev.famine.body: Years of poor harvests; grain prices soar and the streets fill with the gaunt.
worldev.plague.body: A plague spreads from the harbor; every door is shut.
worldev.war.body: Beacon-fires on the frontier ignite the times; the Wardens call to arms.
worldev.golden_age.body: Trade flows, granaries fill; the streets brim with long-lost cheer.
worldev.renaissance.body: New learning and old craft contend; academies and workshops burn the midnight oil.
worldev.starfall.body: Meteors tear the long night; all look up, filled with unspoken awe.
narr.scene.weather_clear: The sky is clear — a rare bright day.
narr.scene.weather_rain: Fine rain slants down; eaves drip in threads.
narr.scene.weather_storm: A storm beats the window; thunder rolls across the sky.
narr.scene.weather_snow: Snow falls quietly; the world turns white.
narr.scene.weather_fog: Fog creeps over the streets; figures blur a few steps away.
narr.scene.weather_drought: A long drought has cracked the pale earth.
narr.scene.weather_heat: Heat shimmers; even the air seems to bend.
narr.era.era_dawn: In the Era of Dawn, hearth-smoke guards the untilled wilds.
narr.era.era_iron: In the Era of Iron, the forge-fires never sleep.
narr.era.era_steam: In the Era of Steam, the roar of gears replaces the hush.
narr.era.era_electric: In the Era of Electric, the long night is smoothed by lamplight.
narr.era.era_star: In the Era of Stars, eyes begin to look past the clouds.
narr.region.reg_heartland: Here in the Heartland, trade roads meet.
narr.region.reg_highland: Here in the Highland, recitation mingles with mountain wind.
narr.region.reg_harbor: Here in Star Harbor, the sea-wind is salt all year.
narr.region.reg_wastes: Here in the Wastes, even the rules give way.
narr.pressure.nature.hi: The seasons have lost their footing; the sky is fickle.
narr.pressure.nature.lo: Nature is calm; things grow at their own pace.
narr.pressure.society.hi: Voices churn in the alleys; undercurrents swell.
narr.pressure.society.lo: The streets are oddly quiet, as if all held their breath.
narr.pressure.economy.hi: The market hums with coin and crowd.
narr.pressure.economy.lo: Counters gather dust; a chill spreads through trade.
narr.pressure.culture.hi: In schools and teahouses, more talk of new learning.
narr.pressure.culture.lo: Old ways hold, yet a weariness seeps through the pages.
narr.pressure.supernatural.hi: Something whispers at night; the wind carries an uneasy hunch.
narr.pressure.supernatural.lo: The uncanny recedes; the world is plain and clear.
narr.pressure.meta.hi: Hearts brighten with the light, loose and easy.
narr.pressure.meta.lo: The air is heavy; even breathing turns careful.
narr.mood.hopeful: You walk slowly, but you don't stop.
narr.mood.weary: Weariness washes over you in waves.
narr.mood.angry: Yet a fire smolders in your chest.
narr.mood.sorrowful: A weight of gloom sits on your heart.
narr.mood.sick: Your body is heavy; even lifting a hand is a chore.
narr.mood.neutral: The days carry on as usual.
narr.close.1: And so the year slips by.
narr.close.2: You tuck it away in memory.
npc.detail.title: {name}
npc.life.child: A familiar face had a child.
npc.life.friendMade: Someone you know made a new friend.
npc.life.rivalMade: Someone you know made an enemy.
npc.life.windfall: Someone you know struck it rich.
npc.life.ruin: Someone you know fell on hard times.
npc.scheme.family.inheritance: A family quarrel over the estate — you came out ahead, if not clean.
npc.scheme.family.estrangement: A relative cut ties with the family.
npc.scheme.friend.gossip.good: Your friends talked you up around town.
npc.scheme.friend.gossip.bad: Your friends' loose talk hurt your name.
npc.scheme.friend.lifeline: A true friend pulled you back from the brink.
npc.scheme.friend.console: A friend came to stand by someone they care about.
npc.scheme.mentor.patronage: Your mentor put their name behind yours.
npc.scheme.mentor.wisdom: Your mentor's words stayed with you.
npc.scheme.partner.support: Your partner was there for you.
npc.scheme.partner.jealousy: Jealousy soured things with your partner.
npc.scheme.partner.care: Your partner nursed them through illness.
npc.scheme.work.betrayal: A colleague sold you out — and took your money with it.
npc.scheme.work.poach: A colleague lured talent away from a rival.
npc.scheme.rival.sabotage: Your rival sabotaged someone close to you.
npc.scheme.rival.blackmail: Your rival came to collect — pay, or pay in pain.
npc.scheme.rival.frame: Your rival framed you, and your name paid for it.
npc.scheme.rival.snare: Your rival set a snare you did not see coming.
npc.scheme.rival.envy: Your rival stewed over another's good fortune.
npc.it.help.result: They were grateful for your help.
npc.it.confide.result: You feel lighter after opening up.
npc.it.activity.result: You spent a lovely time together.
npc.au.family.care.result: Your family worried about your health.
npc.au.friend.gift.result: A friend brought you a little gift.
npc.au.friend.gossip.result: Your friend shared some fun stories.
npc.au.mentor.book.result: Your mentor lent you a good book.
npc.au.partner.support.result: Your partner quietly stayed by you.
npc.au.partner.surprise.result: Your partner prepared a nice surprise.
npc.au.work.bonus.result: Good work earned you a bonus.
npc.au.pet.cuddle.result: Your pet nuzzled up to you.
npc.au.pet.mischief.result: Your pet made a mess at home.
npc.au.family.gathering.text: Your family suggests a weekend gathering. Go?
npc.au.family.gathering.result.go: You went home and had a warm time.
npc.au.family.gathering.result.skip: You skipped it; your family was let down.
npc.au.friend.trip.text: A friend invites you on a weekend trip. Go?
npc.au.friend.trip.result.go: You both had a great time.
npc.au.mentor.referral.text: Your mentor offers to recommend you. Accept?
npc.au.partner.date.text: Your partner wants a date, but you're busy.
npc.au.partner.date.result.go: You spent a romantic day together.
npc.au.partner.date.result.busy: You were busy; your partner felt let down.
npc.au.work.overtime.text: Your boss asks you to work the weekend. Agree?
npc.au.work.overtime.result.accept: You worked overtime, tired but paid.
npc.au.pet.lost.text: Your pet is missing. Go look for it?
npc.au.pet.lost.result.search: You found your pet; it leapt into your arms.
npc.mom.line1: Eat something before you go. I packed it — don't let it go cold.
npc.mom.line2: When you were small you held my sleeve on this street. Now you walk ahead of me.
npc.dad.line2: Whatever you decide — mind the road, and don't owe anyone.
npc.friend.line1: You still owe me a meal from school. Don't think I've forgotten.
npc.friend.line2: If things ever go bad, say the word. I'll be there.
npc.teacher.line1: You were never the quickest, but you were the one who kept coming back.
npc.teacher.line2: Bring me your questions — even the stupid ones. Especially the stupid ones.
npc.partner.line1: You've been carrying something all week. Tell me, or sleep on the sofa.
npc.partner.line2: We can be poor together. Just don't become a stranger to me.
npc.boss.line1: I don't need your loyalty. I need the number by Friday.
npc.boss.line2: Take the overtime. When the tide turns, I remember who stayed.
npc.child.line2: Do grown-ups stop dreaming? You still dream, right?
npc.colleague.line1: Careful — that project's a graveyard. Two people rolled onto it and never came back.
npc.colleague.line2: Canteen at noon? I'll save you a seat.
npc.neighbor.line1: Your mother called. She says you haven't been eating right.
npc.neighbor.line2: I pickled too much cabbage. Take a jar — don't be polite.
npc.pet.line1: (He drops a chewed shoe at your feet and waits.)
npc.pet.line2: (He leans his whole weight against your leg and sighs.)

level.infancy.desc: The first two years — crying, laughing, and first steps.
level.legacy.desc: Past seventy, you live out your years in memory and legacy.
item.bicycle.desc: The cheapest freedom there is; a ride lifts both body and mood.
item.photo.desc: A moment pressed flat; look at it and the years come back warm.
ev.baby_illness.text: At two in the morning your baby is burning up and shaking; the taxi company says twenty minutes and the hospital is nine blocks away.
ev.baby_illness.note.hospital: A nurse takes the baby from your arms at the door. By dawn the fever has broken and you are still in yesterday's shirt.
ev.baby_illness.note.home: You sponge the small body until five. The fever falls; you do not sleep, and you do not tell anyone.
ev.best_friend.text: Your friend tells you, in the stairwell between classes, something they have never told anyone.
ev.best_friend.note.share: You carry it for years. When they need you at sixteen you are already there, because you always knew.
ev.best_friend.note.keep: You nod, say nothing, and the friendship cools by one degree a year.
ev.lost_pet.text: The dog is gone from the yard; the gate is open, and the bowl is still full from this morning.
ev.lost_pet.note.search: You find it two streets over, wet and shaking, behind the bins. It sleeps against your leg for a week.
ev.lost_pet.note.wait: You keep the bowl full for a month. It never comes back, and you never get another dog.
ev.part_time.text: The restaurant on the corner needs a weekend dishwasher, and the owner says you can eat there for free.
ev.part_time.note.take: Your first wages, forty yuan, folded in the sock drawer. You eat more of their food than you should.
ev.part_time.note.study: You keep your weekends for the books. At eleven you are the best in the class and the least rich.
ev.crush.text: You have written the same three sentences in your head for a month, and cannot get past the first one on paper.
ev.crush.note.confess: They read it twice and look up. You will remember the exact colour of the light that afternoon.
ev.crush.note.silent: You burn it in the sink. The words stay in your handwriting somewhere behind your ribs.
ev.travel_day.text: You have counted the money twice: enough for one real journey, or for one year of not worrying.
ev.travel_day.note.go: You go, and come back with sand in the seams and one photograph that lives on the fridge for decades.
ev.travel_day.note.stay: You put it in the bank and watch the interest. Nothing happens, which is the point.
ev.rent_room.text: Two flats, a month apart in age: a small loud one above the night market, a large quiet one an hour out.
ev.rent_room.opt.city: The small one above the market
ev.rent_room.opt.suburb: The quiet one an hour out
ev.rent_room.note.city: You are never short of a meal or a friend, and never long on sleep.
ev.rent_room.note.suburb: You sleep well and commute in the dark, and know none of your neighbours' names.
ev.blind_date.text: An aunt has arranged it and is already seated at the next table, pretending not to watch.
ev.blind_date.note.go: You talk for two hours and forget the aunt entirely. You call each other the next day.
ev.blind_date.note.skip: You finish the tea and go. Your aunt calls your mother before you reach home.
ev.mortgage.text: The bank man writes the number on a form: thirty years, and the flat is small and far but it would be yours.
ev.mortgage.opt.rent: Tear it up and keep renting
ev.mortgage.note.buy: Your signature is unsteady. The keys are cut that afternoon and you sleep on the floor the first night.
ev.mortgage.note.rent: You keep the money flexible and the walls not yours. You move four more times.
ev.health_scan.text: The doctor offers a full check-up; it costs a day and a little money, and finds what it finds.
ev.health_scan.note.check: They find something early and small, and take it out in twenty minutes on a Tuesday.
ev.health_scan.note.ignore: You say you're fine. You say it again in six months, and again two years later.
ev.retirement_plan.text: You draw two columns on the back of an envelope: one for saving, one for the things you keep postponing.
ev.retirement_plan.note.save: You die with a comfortable sum and a list of places you did not go.
ev.retirement_plan.note.live: You travel while your knees still work, and arrive in old age with photographs and thin savings.
ev.inheritance.text: The lawyer waits; you must decide what becomes of a lifetime's savings — and of two people you have never met.
ev.inheritance.opt.give: Leave a sum to the scholarship fund
ev.inheritance.opt.keep: Leave it all to your family
ev.inheritance.note.give: It funds a girl from a village to study medicine. She writes to a family that no longer knows how to answer.
ev.inheritance.note.keep: Your children split it, disagree over it, and are grateful to your face.
npc.rival.desc: He started on the same day you did; whatever you have, he has one more, and he keeps a tally he never shows you.
npc.rival.line2: One day you'll need something from me. I can wait.
npc.au.rival.sabotage.text: You find your work sabotaged. What now?
npc.au.rival.sabotage.result.expose: You expose them; it earns respect.
npc.au.rival.sabotage.result.retaliate: You hit back; the feud deepens.
npc.au.rival.poison.text: You feel off — someone may have drugged you.
npc.au.rival.poison.result.resist: You tough it out, badly weakened.
npc.au.rival.poison.result.revenge: You trace it back, and keep score.
npc.au.friend.confess.text: Your friend stammers: it's long been more than friendship.

career.clerk.desc: A desk, a stamp, a queue that never ends — and a ladder you climb one rung a year.
career.teacher.desc: You stand at the front and give away what you know; their results become your name.
career.artist.desc: You live on inspiration and wilt a little between commissions; fame, if it comes, pays.
career.trader.desc: Buy low, sell high, and learn that capital is a kind of patience.
career.engineer.desc: You solve what can be solved, and are blamed for what cannot.
world.classic.desc: An ordinary world: a temperate land of eras, factions and neighbours — birth to old age, once.
